decision.rule: The user flow is Story list -> Section list -> Quest list -> Quest detail; section boundaries and ordering come only from canonical hierarchy metadata.
decision.must_not: Flatten the hierarchy or derive sections from display text.

decision.rule: Every user-facing location and section label is resolved from canonical metadata; technical IDs are internal only.
decision.must_not: Format start_path or dark_forest directly for UI.

decision.rule: The active quest detail presents its current canonical objective/progress text and does not invent a target from quest type or ID.
decision.must_not: Guess active target from title, location ID, or quest number.

decision.rule: Quest entries distinguish active, available, locked, and completed states; progress belongs to the active quest state and completion is persistent.
decision.must_not: Treat unavailable as completed or expose stale progress after completion.

decision.rule: Callbacks form a bounded hierarchy and every detail/list surface returns to its immediate parent, while the root returns to the canonical profile/account surface.
decision.must_not: Create dead-end callbacks or return directly to an unrelated menu.

decision.rule: Visibility and labels follow V1 hierarchy policy: completed remains visible, active is identifiable, available can be opened, and locked remains non-actionable without leaking spoiler titles.
decision.spoiler_policy: Locked quest labels use the canonical spoiler-safe title presentation path.
decision.must_not: Expose locked quest spoiler titles or make locked entries actionable.

decision.rule: All Ukrainian user-facing Story navigation uses 'розділ'; forms of 'глава' are forbidden in UI text and metadata.
decision.scope: User-visible runtime strings and Story navigation metadata; historical tests/reports/comments are evidence only and not runtime defects.

decision.rule: Stable story/location/section/quest IDs remain internal keys and all human labels are obtained through canonical resolvers or authoritative metadata.
decision.must_not: Humanize IDs with replace/strip/title or duplicate label maps in handlers.

parity_resolution_requirements: Classify every runtime-owner forbidden-term hit as user-visible, metadata, comment, or test-only.
Verify exact callback grammar and immediate-parent return paths.
Verify active/available/locked/completed state derivation from persisted V1 state.
Verify spoiler-safe locked quest labels and canonical location/section resolvers.
Produce a resolved 8/8 contract matrix before any implementation.
